plugins.name: Obsidian
plugins.author: Ryoku Team
plugins.summary: Quick-capture into your Obsidian vault, right from the desktop.
plugins.description: A desktop-widget plugin that adopts your existing Obsidian vault and settings, then turns the everyday moves into two views: a Board of tappable workflow blocks and a Graph of your vault. Create or open today's daily note (with your folder, filename format, and template), open any note, and append text, tasks, links, pasted images, or voice memos - with a live elapsed timer, a discard, and attachments filed next to the target note. Capture retargets are one-off (the default inbox stays a setting), delete asks with a second tap, Enter drives the pickers, and the Graph runs its layout only when the vault changes - tap a node to spotlight it, tap again to open. Local-first and opt-in - nothing runs until you pick a vault, and notes are written straight to disk.
plugins.tagline: Quick-capture into your Obsidian vault, right from the desktop.

plugins.name: Key Visualizer
plugins.author: Himanshu
plugins.summary: Shows the keys you press on screen in a customizable overlay.
plugins.description: A topbar-glyph plugin and screen overlay for Hyprland that displays real-time keyboard presses and shortcuts on screen. Features configurable screen positioning (corners/center), margin, linger duration, and chord history stack, with a topbar icon to quickly toggle or pause display.
plugins.tagline: Shows the keys you press on screen in a customizable overlay.

plugins.name: Market
plugins.author: Ryoku Team
plugins.summary: Track a watchlist of stocks, indices, and crypto on your desktop.
plugins.description: A desktop-widget plugin that tracks a watchlist of up to six Yahoo Finance symbols - crypto pairs (BTC-USD), stocks (AAPL), indices (^GSPC) - and renders the active one's live price, change, and history in one of four faces: a dossier hero with a layered 2.5D ridgeline chart and the watchlist rows, a gridded line, a gradient area, or a compact ticker board. Timeframe chips (1D/1W/1M/1Y) live on the tile, the change always matches the window under the chart, hovering a chart reads out the exact sample, and the tile tells the truth about its data: fetching, error, session state, as-of stamp, and a stale flag. Rising is green, falling is vermilion, on any wallpaper. Free data, no API key.
plugins.tagline: Track a watchlist of stocks, indices, and crypto on your desktop.

plugins.name: Photo Frame
plugins.author: Ryoku Team
plugins.summary: Pin a photo to your desktop, framed the way you like it.
plugins.description: A desktop-widget plugin that pins any photo to your wallpaper in a chosen frame style - rounded, square, polaroid, framed, or film - with a tunable drop shadow and live colour filters (mono, noir, sepia, warm, cool, vivid, fade). Drag, resize, and place it alongside your clock and weather; it ships with a sample photo so it looks right the moment you enable it.
plugins.tagline: Pin a photo to your desktop, framed the way you like it.

plugins.name: Stargate
plugins.author: Ryoku Team
plugins.summary: A living Stargate that dials the time on your desktop.
plugins.description: A desktop-widget plugin that turns the clock into a dialing Stargate: it encodes the time as a seven-glyph gate address and dials it live - the ring turns, the chevrons lock in sequence, the event horizon opens, and it re-dials each minute. Four faces: Naquadah, a cinematic Milky Way ring with engraved glyphs, red chevrons and a liquid event horizon; Hologram, an Ancient cyan projection with a scan beam and amber-energised locks; Dossier, a declassified SGC dialing log with a rotated ink stamp and a printed address block; and Inscription, which drops the clock and carves any sentence you type into gate glyphs on a stone tablet. Built-in procedural glyphs need no font; add a cap_resources Stargate font for the authentic symbols.
plugins.tagline: A living Stargate that dials the time on your desktop.
